scripts.title: Damage Editor
scripts.script:
local settings = {repeatamount = 26, exceptions = {"SayMessageRequest","MeleeUpdateEvent","NinjaBombEvent","BulletUpdateEvent"}}

local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
local old = mt.__namecall
setreadonly(mt, false)

mt.__namecall = function(uh, ...)
  local args = {...}
  local method = getnamecallmethod()
  for i,o in next, settings.exceptions do
      if uh.Name == o then
          return old(uh, ...)
      end
  end
  if method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
      for i = 1,settings.repeatamount do
          old(uh, ...)
      end
  end
  return old(uh, ...)
end

setreadonly(mt, true)

scripts.script:
local r_s = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local remote = r_s.Remote
local store = require(r_s.ModuleScripts.LocalDairebStore)
local data = store.GetStoreProxy("GameData")
local pets = data:GetData("Pets")
local talents = {
    ["AbilityDamage"] = -math.huge,
    ["HitSpeed"] = -math.huge,
    ["Speed"] = -math.huge,
    ["Damage"] = -math.huge
}

for _, pet in ipairs(pets) do
    coroutine.wrap(function()
        remote.SVMachine:FireServer(pet.UID, talents)
    end)()
end

print("done!")
